_meta.batch: Tadpole 02 YOURSELF (32 terminow) - kontynuacja luku Tadpole po batch_32 (13/245). Kluczowa historia: Mortuga uratowal Tadpole przed utonieciem podczas glebokiego nurkowania - stad jej lojalnosc wobec niego (spojne z opisem Moon z batch_24: Tadpole domaga sie sprawiedliwosci dla 'swojego zamordowanego kapitana').
_meta.character_voice: Tadpole: pewna siebie, bezposrednia, lekko tajemnicza co do przeszlosci (patrz batch_32).

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
So, Madam Tadpole.
You're a professional [i]swimmer...?[/i] Or a professional [i]mermaid?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl:
Więc, Madam Tadpole.
Jesteś zawodową [i]pływaczką...?[/i] Czy zawodową [i]syreną?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
Nope, it's a tattoo.
Sorry to disappoint.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl:
Nie, to tatuaż.
Przykro mi, że rozczarowuję.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I've always been real good at holding my breath underwater. Like [h]scary[/h] good.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Zawsze byłam naprawdę dobra w wstrzymywaniu oddechu pod wodą. Jak [h]przerażająco[/h] dobra.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: It's cool. Why d'you get it?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Fajne. Czemu go sobie zrobiłaś?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: How come you're here on the submarine?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Czemu jesteś tu, na łodzi?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: The other kids used to call me [i]fishgirl.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Inne dzieciaki nazywały mnie kiedyś [i]rybią dziewczyną.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Okay, so, I like to go diving - in the sea. [h]Deep.[/h]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Okej, więc, lubię nurkować - w morzu. [h]Głęboko.[/h]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
He brought me back.
I owe him my life.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl:
Sprowadził mnie z powrotem.
Zawdzięczam mu życie.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Somehow, Magnus found me. Pulled me into his submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Jakoś Magnus mnie znalazł. Wciągnął na swoją łódź.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: So - Mortuga saved you from drowning... and you just decided to stay?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Więc - Mortuga uratował cię przed utonięciem... i po prostu postanowiłaś zostać?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: It's where I belong - the ocean.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Tam jest moje miejsce - w oceanie.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
I had my fill of living on land.
I've got no interest in going back.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl:
Miałam dość życia na lądzie.
Nie mam ochoty wracać.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Anyway so one time I went [h]too[/h] deep. I wasn't gonna come back up.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: W każdym razie, raz zeszłam [h]za[/h] głęboko. Nie miałam wrócić na powierzchnię.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Oh, like with an oxygen tank and a mask-
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: O, jak z butlą tlenową i maską-
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: No no no, I don't use any of that stuff.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Nie, nie, nie, nie używam niczego takiego.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I was pretty much done for.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Było ze mną praktycznie po wszystkim.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Wait, so, are you [h]from[/h] Silkwirm? Were you living in the town?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Czekaj, więc jesteś [h]z[/h] Silkwirm? Mieszkałaś w miasteczku?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Nope. I'm from [i]faaar[/i] away.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Nie. Jestem z [i]daaaleka.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: ...then how come you were diving into [i]this[/i] bit of ocean?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: ...to czemu nurkowałaś w [i]tym[/i] akurat kawałku oceanu?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Oh. Well, yeah, I was visiting the town... for work.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Och. No, tak, odwiedzałam miasteczko... służbowo.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: What [i]kinda[/i] work?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Jaką [i]niby[/i] pracę?
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Uh... [i]performance art.[/i] Kinda.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Yy... [i]sztukę performatywną.[/i] Coś w tym stylu.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Like I said, I'm done with all that.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Jak mówiłam, skończyłam z tym wszystkim.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I'd say they had it right.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Powiedziałabym, że mieli rację.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Ah, kids can be mean-
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Ach, dzieci potrafią być okrutne-
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I'm not a professional anything, not anymore.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Nie jestem już zawodowo niczym, już nie.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I'm done with all that.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Skończyłam z tym wszystkim.
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Do you have [i]gills?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Masz [i]skrzela?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Hahaha!
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Hahaha!
Conversation/Tadpole 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Tadpole
